findings.title: TV-2026-1010: Security Update for Multiple Vulnerabilities in TeamViewer Clients and Related Services
findings.summary_md: TeamViewer's trust center bulletin TV-2026-1010, issue date Sep 29, 2026, Priority Important with CVSS up to 8.8, covers five CVEs in TeamViewer Full Client and Host on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It details CVE-2026-92370, an improper access control flaw letting an authenticated remote attacker bypass user-configured session permissions, alongside CVE-2026-19743 (IPC path traversal), CVE-2026-92368 (heap overflow in .tvs session recording playback), CVE-2026-92369 (installer rollback TOCTOU), and CVE-2026-92371 (Cloud Session Recording link resolution). Fixes ship in 15.82 plus legacy builds 15.64.8, 14.7.48855, 13.2.36230, 13.2.153995, and 13.2.153994. The bulletin states TeamViewer is not aware of any public disclosure or active exploitation in the wild.

findings.title: CVE-2026-92370 Detail (NVD)
findings.summary_md: NVD published the record for CVE-2026-92370, the remote session access control bypass in TeamViewer Full Client and Host, on Sep 29, 2026, the same day as the vendor bulletin and before the Sep 30 news coverage. The record carries CVSS 3.1 base score 8.8 with vector CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H, describing an authenticated remote attacker bypassing user-configured permission settings during session establishment, potentially leading to code execution.

findings.title: CVE-2026-19743 Detail (NVD)
findings.summary_md: NVD published the record for CVE-2026-19743, a path traversal in the local IPC service of TeamViewer Full Client and Host prior to 15.82 on Windows, Linux, and macOS, on Sep 29, 2026. A local authenticated low-privileged user can send crafted IPC commands to the service daemon to perform arbitrary file writes with elevated privileges up to NT AUTHORITY/SYSTEM or root, scored CVSS 3.1 7.8.

findings.title: CVE-2026-92368 Detail (NVD)
findings.summary_md: NVD published the record for CVE-2026-92368, a heap-based buffer overflow in processing of .tvs session recording files in TeamViewer Full Client and Host for Linux and macOS from V15.70 prior to V15.82, on Sep 29, 2026. Opening a specially crafted recording through the "Play or convert recorded session..." feature can cause out-of-bounds heap writes and code execution with the current user's privileges, scored CVSS 3.1 7.8.

findings.title: CVE-2026-92369 Detail (NVD)
findings.summary_md: NVD published the record for CVE-2026-92369, a TOCTOU race condition in the Windows installer rollback mechanism of TeamViewer Full Client and Host prior to 15.82, on Sep 29, 2026. A local low-privileged attacker who wins the race can replace rollback backup files in a user-writable temporary directory before an elevated installer restores them, escalating to NT AUTHORITY/SYSTEM, scored CVSS 3.1 7.3.

findings.title: CVE-2026-92371 Detail (NVD)
findings.summary_md: NVD published the record for CVE-2026-92371, an improper link resolution flaw in the Cloud Session Recording functionality of TeamViewer Full Client and Host for Linux from V15.0 prior to V15.82, on Sep 29, 2026. A local authenticated attacker can exploit a race during path validation to cause privileged file operations in unintended locations, scored CVSS 3.1 7.0.
